spans.s: phala (IA 27), a Pāli form of Sanskrit pala.
phāla-divya (IA 17), the ordeal of taking a heated plough-share in hand.
phalahika, cf. sa-phalahikaṃ (LP), with an open space round about the house; same as Gujarātī phaliyuṃ.
phalaka (IE 3-5), a wooden slab used as a slate.
phalita, cf. phalita-pade (LP), also Gujarātī huṃḍī pāke tyāre, ‘when the bill of exchange becomes due’.
phalaratika (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, p. 135), refers probably to the right to enjoy all kinds of fruits in the gift land without special permission that was necessary for ordinary tenants.
